Invited talks, conference presentations, panels, tutorials, workshops, and professional presentations form an important part of my academic and technical activity.

This archive is being reconstructed from curriculum records, institutional sources, event programs, and historical material. It records presentations for which there is documentary evidence; simple event attendance and academic-service activities are maintained separately.
